text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money, because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing: team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality, since everyone follows the same standards and good practices. Although code reviews take extra time, they are worth the effort. They make the code cleaner, the team stronger, and the final product more reliable.
